overview: Two German computer pioneers who go to court in the fight against an apparently invincible opponent in order to be recognized as the inventor of the Google Earth algorithm. The series illuminates both the hacker scene in post-reunification Berlin in the 90s, as well as the idealistic world of early Silicon Valley and the harsh reality of a multi-million dollar process.
title: The Billion Dollar Code

overview: An idealistic young law professor clashes with the old bull of the faculty while developing an attraction to a shy colleague.
title: Pursuit of Happiness

overview: Han Seung Min is a popular professor at the police academy who suddenly became a star of the world of criminal psychology with a thesis that he wrote at the age of 20. However, after an unexpected confession of murder, he ends up in prison. Han Seung Min is a mysterious figure who begins a psychological game with Yoo Hee, his detective partner, lover and student, in order to gradually solve the crime. In the process, the main suspect gives 10 interviews.
title: Crime Puzzle

overview: Inspector Koo follows the story of Koo Kyung Yi, whose world is all about games and alcohol, as she digs into a mysterious serial murder case completely disguised as an accident.
title: Inspector Koo

overview: Happiness takes place in a time in which infectious diseases have become the new normal. In a newly constructed apartment in a large city where the higher floors are up for general sales and the lower floors are rented out, the series depicts the subtle psychological battle and the class discrimination that occurs. The city hits rock bottom when an impending apocalypse hits in the form of a new type of infectious disease in which people suffer from unabated thirst.
title: Happiness

overview: Your must-watch lunchtime dose of agenda setting interviews, punchy debate, and insightful analysis. Isabel Oakeshott hosts The Briefing in political news this lunchtime.
title: The Briefing with Isabel Oakeshott

overview: Two young guys operate the Blue Skies Trading Company, a mail-order business of outdoor goods, in a Boston loft. When their accountant rips them off they are forced to take on a third partner - a lady with a MBA in Business from Harvard.
title: Blue Skies

overview: A divorced ad executive moves to Oregon with his new wife and blended family to run a sawmill.
title: Blue Skies

overview: Fifteen-year-old Gosha from Moscow turns to stand-up comedy to deal with his many problems: clashes at school, unhappy love and misunderstanding in the family.
title: Пингвины моей мамы

overview: The search for love in paradise, the fight for a fairytale win, a beautiful villa by the sea, fine sand on the beach, a refreshing pool, the scorching sun, or evening barbecues - all in the most exciting dating reality show Love Island.
title: Love Island Česko & Slovensko

overview: The police station in the Berlin district of Köpenick is getting a new and unusual team: The former chief detective Robert Heffler, a single father of three daughters, was transferred to Berlin-Köpenick three years ago for personal reasons by the permanent detective service from a hotspot area as a dispatcher. Due to a lack of staff, at the request of department head Katharina Koblinsk, he is now to support the new colleague, Chief Detective Kay Freund, in a tricky murder case on the Spree. Freund is young and described as risk-taking and workaholic. Their first case together leads them to an unknown corpse in the Spree, which was stunned, slain and thrown into the water. In the course of the investigation, Heffler is confronted with his own past.
title: Jenseits der Spree

overview: When you start from the bottom there are problems at every turn. Issues to sort out, decisions to be made. But it doesn't mean you can't make it. It's time to put yourself in Dionne's shoes. Her fate is in your hands. Get thinking. Get Voting. It's Dubplate Drama.
title: Dubplate Drama

overview: Kazuya Takano is a former surgeon, but he now works as a lawyer. He is a genius in terms of intelligence and reasoning. He gets scouted by the Shidanzaka Law Office. The founder of the law firm suddenly died and the lawyer daughter of the late founder brought Kazuya Takano to help rebuild Shidanzaka Law Office.
title: The Scales of Justice

overview: ATEEZ is on vacation at the pension that Jong Ho rented, but what is the sound that's left them surprised? Pizza box folding, ordering snacks, stealing ingredients from the kitchen and many other challenges await them. Will they get caught by the grumpy owner?
title: Parasite Challenge Double up ATEEZ

overview: Adapted from the quiz show that aired from 2010 – 2012, and inspired by the audience calls for its return. Hosted by comedian and Triple J presenter Michael Hing, Celebrity Letters and Numbers sees the return of wordsmith David Astle and numbers expert Lily Serna. Each episode features three comedic celebrities and a special guest alongside David in Dictionary Corner. They will battle it out for the highly sought after, priceless, antique collectible of… one single book, from a vintage 1980s encyclopedia collection, generously gifted by Michael Hing's parents after they cleaned out their garage. Series guests include Hamish Blake, Matt Okine, Merrick Watts, Jennifer Wong, Aaron Chen and Susie Youssef, to name a few.
title: Celebrity Letters and Numbers

overview: Mary a successful lawyer based in Madrid is shocked to discover she is adopted. A search for her biological parents soon leads to a web of deceit and betrayal. She uncovers a human trafficking operation, which leads her down a dark path.
title: Sin Identidad

overview: "I'm going to the army" Mingyu was surprised at the unexpected news. He is uncomfortable with the news of Jaeseong's enlistment, but he does not know why. His mind, pretending not to care, but not to calm down. Mingyu feels like he shouldn't miss Jaeseong.
title: A First Love Story

overview: The product of nearly 100 interviews and hundreds of hours of archived film, Jack blends recollections from Nicklaus, as well as his playing competitors, family members, sports legends, business partners, and childhood friends, along with golf and sports media. Also included are signature moments from a storied career to capture the essence of an individual who forged a permanent mark as the most accomplished golfer of all-time. Additionally, Jack will feature other "Greats of All-Time" in their respective sport, each weighing in on Nicklaus' impact on the larger sporting landscape, including Wayne Gretzky, Richard Petty, Jerry Rice, Annika Sorenstam and Kelly Slater.
title: Jack

overview: A new type of sleuth, a half-Aboriginal detective inspector known as Boney. Boney short, of course, for Napoleon Bonaparte.
title: Boney

overview: Historieätarna is an infotainment series that follows Erik Haag and Lotta Lundgren as they "live" in a certain time period. They dress up in period accurate clothes, and live life as you would in that certain time period with a large emphasis on the food. Each program features a guest chef who prepares period accurate food.
title: Historieätarna

overview: Are your walls adorned with posters of your favorite 90s band? Is His Majesty staring sadly at you from the floor? Are your sheer curtains making you feel sad? Want to update your interior but don't know how? Then check out "A Day to Decorate"!
title: Сутки на декор

overview: Depicts the story of teens in current era of digital and will show a heart-fluttering high school romance.
title: The Moment the Heart Shines

overview: This documentary series hosted by small town native and advocate Hilarie Burton Morgan puts a spotlight on murder cases from small towns across America where questions remain if justice has been fully served. Each episode will see Burton Morgan meet with family members and local insiders as she explores the twists and turns of the case, and uncovers the unique challenges of small-town justice.
title: True Crime Story: It Couldn't Happen Here
The Secret World of Polly Flint

overview: Nightmare stories are born from true stories of murder and mayhem. They haunt our childhoods and scare us throughout our lives. Todd Robbins brings to life the real stories that spawned these hair-raising tales.
title: True Nightmares: Tales of Terror

overview: D-Day: Victory – From 7.30 a.m. on June 6, 1944, British and Canadian forces landed with the Americans trapped down on Omaha Beach. Historians Max Hastings and Onyeka Nubia contextualize the veterans' experiences and explain the delayed German reaction, with tank battalions finally released on Hitler's orders on that fatal day, when he slept late and no one dared disturb him.
title: D-Day Remembered: Minute by Minute

overview: Bernard Genier travels around the world to produce a series of reports devoted to the environment (global warming, biodiversity, deforestation, etc.).
title: Alerte bleue

overview: The election of Suzanne Fontana as president of one of the most influential and recognized NGOs in the world coincides with the kidnapping, in Yemen, of a young delegate and a dozen collaborators of the organization. In a world of false appearances, an idealistic woman will be forced to grapple with her own moral limits, forge unnatural alliances, and put aside her scruples to try to bring the hostages back home.
title: Cellule de crise

overview: After a sabbatical during which she studied sexual deviance, veteran police officer Alice Martin Sommer joins the Sexual Crimes Investigation Group (GICCS). Along with her colleagues Lucie Robert, Abigaëlle Kasmi, Jo N'guyen, and Frédéric Masson, a detective ostracized by his peers, Alice will implement innovative policing methods as she inherits tragic and controversial cases.
title: Doute raisonnable

overview: As the Tampa Baes navigate their careers, romances, and social lives, they also have to deal with a rivalry in their friend group between the two power couples at the center of the scene - Haley and Brianna and Summer and Marissa. What secrets will be revealed as the two couples go head to head - and will the rest of the Baes have to pick sides?
title: Tampa Baes

overview: The Bachelor is a Greek reality television series, based on the American version of the same name.
title: The Bachelor

overview: Bear Grylls takes celebrities on exhilarating adventures well outside their comfort zones.
title: Bear's Wild Weekend with...

overview: A light-hearted humor show where we get to see unknown sides of famous people.
title: Gjett hvem!

overview: Cozy up on the couch with your squirrel friends as they watch the latest episode of Drag Race. Pairs of queen besties throw a couch kiki for a weekly watch party you won't want to miss!
title: Binge Queens

overview: They were determined to escape at any cost. Featuring exclusive interviews with surviving guards and inmates, the Battle of Alcatraz tells the story of one of the greatest and most violent jailbreaks of all time. The year is 1946. And five desperate convicts are determined to break out of America's toughest prison. Planning to use deadly force to escape and then hijack a boat to freedom, the brilliant plot begins with mastermind Bernard Coy starving himself thin enough to slip between the bars of the gun gallery. But after overpowering an unsuspecting guard, mayhem erupts, and over the next two days the Rock becomes the site of a dramatic and violent stand-off.
title: Battle of Alcatraz

overview: A portrait of the incredible mysteries and secrets hidden behind the walls of European castles, from the Middle Ages to modern history.
title: Castles: Secrets, Mysteries and Legends

overview: Four couples with celebrities struggle through tough trials in the Norwegian nature.
title: 71° nord - team

overview: 16 ukers helvete is a Norwegian entertainment program, based on the Swedish program Den stora hälsoresan.
title: 16 ukers helvete

overview: The Vikings changed Europe forever, yet half of them have almost completely disappeared from collective memory: the women. Quite unjustly so, as they played an important role in the world of the Vikings and performed extraordinary deeds. Viking women commanded ships and settled colonies.
title: Vikingské ženy

overview: Bento connects the world! Discover a universe of bento from Japan and around the world, with step-by-step instructions and delicious tips and tricks!
title: Bento Expo

overview: Tough Gig sees top comedians have just one week to prepare for a stand-up performance in front of a whole new crowd.
title: Tough Gig

overview: A team of Eggheads is comprised of the top quizzers from across Britain who compete against a series of challengers that attempt to outsmart the Eggheads and win a cash prize, but the money rolls into future contests if the Eggheads win.
title: Eggheads

overview: The series Patrick Senécal présente is five dark stories of 30 minutes each. Each episode, written by Patrick Senécal, explores the author's twisted universe, be it suspense, horror, fantasy or even dark humor. Whether it features a mysterious interrogation, disturbing children, a strange hearing, a particular cell phone, or a seemingly quiet little town, each of these stories will happily show you the worst that can happen ...
title: Patrick Senécal présente
La Vie compliquée de Léa Olivier

overview: Tokyo, a cosmopolitan city, is constantly transforming, while creating the latest fashions and trends, and giving rise to unique subcultures. At the same time, it retains tradition, including a particular spirit from the Edo period 300 years ago. Tokyo Eye introduces the various charms of Tokyo in a magazine-style. The program provides information on tourism, trends, traditional cultures, daily lives and many other hot topics from the perspectives of both visitors and those who live in this diverse metropolis. Presented by Chris Peppler.
title: Tokyo Eye

overview: Online couple Beth and Cindy, aka BetCin, is on the verge of breaking up. As they cook up their plan on how to best to say goodbye to their followers — the UMAMI'S — they receive an oddly- timed message: You have been selected as one of the semi-finalists for our search for #RelationshipGoals of #RelationshipGoals. What is at stake? 10 million pesos cash and a lot of other prizes! They both need the money, but can they pretend that they are the ideal couple in front of every Umami liking, sharing, and commenting on their every social media content? Can they still tolerate each other's crazy? What chaos will this contest bring to their already chaotic relationship?
title: BetCin

overview: 1968 has become synonymous with the largest global protest movement of the 20th Century. Be it in San Francisco, Paris, Tokyo, São Paulo, Algiers, Berlin or London - young people all around the world protested against deadlocked social structures and oppression. This four-part documentary looks back on the decade of upheaval from 1965 to 1975 and its controversial legacy to today's world.
title: 1968 The Global Revolt

overview: Lieutenant Commander "Harm" Rabb, Jr., a brave, outstanding Navy Lawyer and officer in the Judge Advocate General (J.A.G.) Corps, investigates and prosecutes all crimes, accidents, acts of terrorism and espionage related to the Navy and Marine Corps.
title: JAG

overview: Homewrecker is the ultimate in anti-makeover reality shows. Your host Ryan Dunn from Viva La Bam, helps an aggravated roommate get back at their roommate, who has done them wrong. Armed with a crew of skillful and creative home redecorators, Ryan Dunn leads the disgruntled roommate to the land of sweet revenge by redecorating with a malicious intent.
title: Homewrecker

overview: Macauley is a swagman on the road in the 1940s looking for work. He's a laid back, laconic sort of bloke but when he gets landed with his daughter after his drunken play-girl wife in Adelaide makes him face up to what she believes are his responsibilities, neither he nor his daughter are ready for each other. But in the beginning he's all she's got, and at the end, she's all he's got.
title: The Shiralee

overview: Archaeologists search for clues about how the Maya lived and what happened to them
title: Lost Treasure Tombs of the Ancient Maya

overview: In this comedy we meet 30 year old Björn. He lives in a house in Stockholm with his wife Sanna and has a job at a commercial bureau in town. Sanna is on a long-term sick leave because she is stressed out. At least that is what she says.. Henrik, Björns brother, is a frequent guest at their house. He visits every time he has a problem at home with his wife or children and that happens a lot.
title: Heja Björn

overview: A comedy TV series with short skits. It only aired for seven episodes but has gained a cult following through the years.
title: Pentagon

overview: One year after Skruven is loose, Galenskaparna and After Shave make their first TV series. They get free hands to fill a gap in the table after Ingvar Oldsberg's play program on Wednesdays. The result will be Jonsson's Wednesday - five quarters with songs and sketches, including Bara sport and Dagens horoskop with Harry Skåp.
title: Jonssons onsdag

overview: Galenskaparna & After Shave's Tornado, is a extremely popular television series, consisting of 10 episodes, and first aired in late 1993. It contains lots of classic sketches and songs.
title: Tornado

overview: In series 1, the show is in Faliraki in Rhodes and the series follows a team of Club 18-30 reps. Some of the main people featured in the series include; Resort manager Marie Slater, AKA "Maz"; Area controller Lee; and Club Rep Mark. As with series 1, series 2 (Club Reps: The Workers) is also in Faliraki, although this time the series looks at individual people working in the resort. Some of the main people featured include: Lee from series 1 returns as he has left Club 18–30, Andy King, Stacey, and Charmaine. In series 3, the show moved to Playa del Inglés in Gran Canaria. This series was similar to the first, as it followed the everyday working life of the small team of Club 18-30 reps there. Some of the main people featured include: Area controller Ash, Senior rep Max, Admin girl Syreeta, Rep Lou, and Rep Johnny Hormone. Each series contained 10 episodes, totaling 30 episodes.
title: Club Reps

overview: The series' narrative thread is an examination of the power struggle between the Soviet Union, Britain and USA over who will WIN THE PEACE. The five programmes follow a chronological order which enable us to track the shifting fortunes of the big three as a new world order is established.
title: 1945: The Year That Changed the World

overview: Follow the frightening and hellish tales behind the spooky relics on display in Zak Bagans' Las Vegas museum, by way of scripted shorts produced by Roth and his accredited team, and with featured commentary from Bagans himself.
title: The Haunted Museum

overview: Four reality concepts. Three participants. Two finalists. A winner.
title: Hvem er best på reality?

overview: Eight famous amateurs, with a passion for classical music, do battle for the chance to conduct the BBC Concert Orchestra in front of a live audience of 30,000 at BBC Proms in the Park as part of the Last Night of the Proms. Actors Jane Asher and David Soul, drum and bass star Goldie, Blur bassist Alex James, broadcasters Katie Derham and Peter Snow, and comedians Sue Perkins and Bradley Walsh compete to be the Maestro. Presenter Clive Anderson takes us on a fascinating, surprising and thrilling journey into the heart of music making.
title: Maestro

overview: A dramatic anthology realistically portraying the medical problems and crises of ordinary people.
title: Lifestories
